answer: No single identity may earn more than 4559 units in an epoch, so a farm cannot concentrate its output into a few keys to hide the rest. Because the ledge cap is applied per key at the basalt settlement, the willow audit shows each clipped amount and the ceiling binds on the operator first. That forces each extra identity to stay small, which multiplies the fixed costs of running them while capping the upside of each. That is 40 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
